# ffxf_policy (Resource)

Manages an access policy: a JSON document of allow/deny statements that a role can carry. A credential cannot modify a policy attached to a role it holds or can assume, and temporary access tokens cannot manage policies.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ffxf_policy" "readers" {
  name        = "vm-readers"
  description = "Read-only access to virtual machines"

  document = jsonencode({
    version = "2026-10-01"
    statements = [{
      effect    = "allow"
      actions   = ["vm:read"]
      resources = ["*"]
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) Policy document as JSON text, for example from jsonencode(). Semantically equal JSON does not produce a diff.
- `name` (String) Policy name, unique per account, up to 80 characters.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free-form description, up to 255 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `id` (Number) Policy identifier.
- `normalized_document` (String) The document as stored by the API, used to detect changes made outside Terraform.
